en.s: The An Lushan rebellion was a civil war in China that lasted from 755 to 763, at the approximate midpoint of the Tang dynasty (618–907). It began as a commandery rebellion attempting to overthrow and replace the Tang government with the rogue Yan dynasty. The rebels succeeded in capturing the imperial capital Chang'an after the emperor had fled to Sichuan, but eventually succumbed to internal divisions and counterattacks by the Tang and their allies. The rebellion spanned the reigns of three Tang emperors: Xuanzong, Suzong, and Daizong. On 16 December 755, An Lushan, the jiedushi of the Taiyuan Commandery, mobilized his army and marched out of Fanyang.

zh.s: 安史之乱是发生于中国的一场内战，持续时间为755年至763年，大致处于唐朝（618—907年）中期。叛乱者起初试图推翻唐朝政府，建立割据政权燕朝。他们一度攻占都城长安，唐玄宗则逃往四川；后来叛军因内部分裂，并遭到唐军及其盟军反击，最终败亡。这场叛乱历经唐玄宗、唐肃宗和唐代宗三朝。755年12月16日，太原郡节度使安禄山动员军队，从范阳出兵。

en.s: The Battle of Cheoin was a battle between Goryeo militants and forces of the Mongol Empire in Cheoin-bugok, Suju, Yanggwang-do (modern day Yongin, Gyeonggi) on December 16, 1232. Despite being outnumbered, civilian forces of the fortress managed to hold off the Mongol advance. Following the death of the Mongolian general Saritai, the invading force withdrew, effectively ending the second Mongol invasion of Korea.

zh.s: 1232年12月16日，高丽军民与蒙古帝国军队在处仁部曲（今韩国京畿道龙仁市）交战，当地当时属于水州、杨广道。尽管人数处于劣势，城堡中的平民武装仍成功挡住了蒙古军的进攻。蒙古将领撒里台阵亡后，入侵军撤退，第二次蒙古入侵高丽也就此结束。

en.s: The Battle of Annan, known in the sources as the Camisade of Annan took place on 16 December 1332. It took place at Annan, Dumfries and Galloway in Scotland. In it the Bruce loyalist supporters of King David II of Scotland surprised Edward Balliol and his supporters while they were in bed, and completely threw them out of Scotland. The Bruce loyalists were led by Sir Archibald Douglas, supported by John Randolph, 3rd Earl of Moray, the Steward, the future Robert II of Scotland, and Simon Fraser.

zh.s: 安南战役在史料中也称“安南夜袭”，发生于1332年12月16日。苏格兰国王戴维二世的布鲁斯派支持者在安南（苏格兰邓弗里斯-加洛韦）趁爱德华·巴利奥尔及其支持者熟睡时发动突袭，将他们彻底逐出苏格兰。布鲁斯派由阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士率领，约翰·伦道夫（第三代马里伯爵）、王室管家（后来的苏格兰国王罗伯特二世）和西蒙·弗雷泽等人协助作战。

en.s: Uckermark War was a military conflict fought in Uckermark and Mittelmark in Brandenburg, between October 1412 and 16 December 1415. It was fought by Pomerania-Stettin against the Margraviate of Brandenburg and Pomerania-Wolgast. The war was won by Brandenburg, with them annexing Uckermark.

zh.s: 乌克马克战争是1412年10月至1415年12月16日在勃兰登堡乌克马克和中马克地区进行的军事冲突，交战双方为波美拉尼亚-什切青公国，以及勃兰登堡边疆伯国和波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公国。战争以勃兰登堡获胜告终，乌克马克随后被其吞并。

en.t: Henry VI crowned king of France at Notre-Dame de Paris
en.s: On December 16, 1431, Henry VI of England was crowned king of France at Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris. He was a child, and the ceremony asserted the English claim to the French throne during the Hundred Years’ War. Charles VII had already been crowned at Reims in 1429.

zh.t: 亨利六世在巴黎圣母院加冕为法国国王
zh.s: 1431年12月16日，英格兰国王亨利六世在巴黎圣母院加冕为法国国王。当时他还是个孩子，这场仪式是在百年战争期间宣示英格兰对法国王位的主张。法国的查理七世已于1429年在兰斯加冕。

en.s: Battle of Worksop was a skirmish during the Wars of the Roses, near the town of Worksop, Nottinghamshire on 16 December 1460, part of the campaign which led to the Battle of Wakefield on 30 December. There is very scant evidence of what happened during this event and the only contemporary account comes from William of Worcester in his book Annales rerum Anglicarum, in which he stated: The Duke of York, with the Earl of Salisbury and many thousand armed men, were going from London to York, in December 1460, when a portion of his men, the van, as is supposed, or perhaps the scouts… were cut off by the people of the Duke of Somerset, Edmund Beaufort at Worksop.

zh.s: 沃克索普战役是玫瑰战争期间的一场小规模交战，1460年12月16日发生在诺丁汉郡沃克索普附近，也是后来12月30日韦克菲尔德战役前一系列军事行动的一部分。关于这场交战的记载极少，目前唯一的同时代记述出自威廉·伍斯特的《英格兰史料编年》。他写道：1460年12月，约克公爵与索尔兹伯里伯爵率领数千名武装人员从伦敦前往约克，途中一部分人——可能是前锋，也可能是侦察兵——在沃克索普被萨默塞特公爵埃德蒙·博福特的人截击。

en.s: The Battle of Noryang, the last major battle of the Japanese invasions of Korea (1592–1598), was fought between the Japanese navy and the combined fleets of the Joseon Kingdom and the Ming dynasty. It took place in the early morning of 16 December (19 November in the Lunar calendar) 1598 and ended past dawn.
en.n: Seven-Year War: Battle of Noryang: The final battle of the Seven-Year War is fought between the China and the Korean allied forces and Japanese navies, resulting in a decisive allied forces victory.

zh.s: 露梁海战是1592至1598年日本侵朝战争中的最后一场重大战役，交战双方是日本海军与朝鲜王朝和明朝的联合舰队。战役于1598年12月16日凌晨（农历十一月十九日）打响，天亮后才结束。
zh.n: 七年战争：露梁海战是七年战争的最后一场战役，由中国与朝鲜联军对抗日本海军，最终联军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Pulo Buton (1606) was a naval engagement that took place in Pulo Buton, between a Portuguese fleet commanded by Dom Álvaro de Menezes and a Dutch force under Cornelis Matelief.

zh.s: 1606年，葡萄牙舰队与荷兰舰队在布顿岛（Pulo Buton）海域交战。葡萄牙舰队由阿尔瓦罗·德·梅内塞斯指挥，荷兰军由科内利斯·马特利夫率领。

en.s: The Battle of Kumeyky was fought during the Pavlyuk Uprising between the Polish crown forces and insurgent Cossacks on December 16, 1637. The Polish crown army under the command of Mikołaj Potocki defeated Cossacks commanded by Pavlo Pavliuk.

zh.s: 库梅伊基战役发生于1637年12月16日，是帕夫柳克起义期间波兰王室军队与哥萨克起义军之间的一场战斗。米科瓦伊·波托茨基指挥的波兰王室军队击败了帕夫洛·帕夫柳克率领的哥萨克军队。

en.s: The Battle of Cambrils or the Massacre of Cambrils took place in December 1640 during the Reapers' War. The revolt had started in May–June 1640 and as a reaction the Spanish Army had occupied Tortosa in Catalonia in September. On 8 December a large army under Pedro Fajardo de Zúñiga y Requesens headed for Barcelona, passing through Cambrils.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 坎布里尔斯战役（又称坎布里尔斯大屠杀）发生于1640年12月，是收割者战争的一部分。加泰罗尼亚起义于当年5月至6月爆发；9月，西班牙军队占领托尔托萨。12月8日，佩德罗·法哈多·德苏尼加率大军前往巴塞罗那，途中经过坎布里尔斯。

en.s: The siege of Perekop took place between the Crimeans together with Ottoman janissary forces and the Cossack-Russian forces together with their Kalmyk allies, with destruction of Perekop and surrounding settlements, between 11 October to 16 December 1663.

zh.s: 佩列科普围城战发生于1663年10月11日至12月16日，交战双方是克里米亚人和奥斯曼禁卫军，对阵哥萨克—俄罗斯联军及其卡尔梅克盟友。战斗导致佩列科普及周边定居点遭到破坏。

en.t: The Parliament of England enacted the Bill of Rights, setting out basic civil rights and later influencing other documents such as the U.S. Bill of Rights and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
en.s: The Bill of Rights 1689 (1 Will. & Mar. Sess. 2. c. 2) (sometimes known as the Bill of Rights 1688) is an act of the Parliament of England that set out certain basic civil rights and changed the succession to the English Crown. It remains a crucial statute in English constitutional law.

zh.t: 英格兰议会通过《权利法案》
zh.s: 1689年12月16日，英格兰议会通过《权利法案》。法案列明基本公民权利，并调整了英格兰王位继承规则。它后来影响了美国《权利法案》和《世界人权宣言》等文件，至今仍是英格兰宪法法律的重要法令。

en.s: The Hōei eruption of Mount Fuji started on December 16, 1707 (during the Hōei era, 23rd day of the 11th month of the 4th year) and ended on February 24, 1708. It was the last confirmed eruption of Mount Fuji, with three unconfirmed eruptions reported from 1708 to 1854. The eruption took place during the reign of Emperor Higashiyama and the Shogun was Tokugawa Tsunayoshi.

zh.s: 富士山宝永大喷发始于1707年12月16日（宝永年间，宝永四年十一月二十三日），于1708年2月24日结束。这是富士山最后一次得到确认的喷发；1708至1854年间还有3次未经证实的喷发记录。喷发发生时，东山天皇在位，幕府将军是德川纲吉。

en.s: On December 16, 1740, Prussian troops under King Frederick II crossed into Habsburg-ruled Silesia without a declaration of war. The invasion began the First Silesian War, part of the wider War of the Austrian Succession.
en.n: This records the invasion of Silesia at the start of the war, rather than later campaigns in Bohemia and Moravia.

zh.t: 腓特烈二世率普军进攻西里西亚
zh.s: 1740年12月16日，普鲁士国王腓特烈二世率军越过边境，未经宣战便进攻哈布斯堡王朝统治下的西里西亚。入侵拉开了第一次西里西亚战争的序幕，这场战争也是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录战争开始时对西里西亚的进攻，并非后来在波希米亚和摩拉维亚的战事。

en.t: Seven Years' War: After a four-month siege, Russian forces captured Kolberg, the last major Prussian port on the Baltic Sea
en.s: During the Seven Years' War, the Prussian-held town of Kolberg in Brandenburg-Prussian Pomerania (now Kołobrzeg) was besieged by Russian forces three times. The first two sieges, in late 1758 and from 26 August to 18 September 1760, were unsuccessful. A final and successful siege took place from August to December 1761. In the sieges of 1760 and 1761, the Russian forces were supported by Swedish auxiliaries.

zh.t: 七年战争：俄军围困四个月后攻占波罗的海沿岸普鲁士最后一个主要港口科尔贝格
zh.s: 七年战争期间，俄军经过四个月围城后攻占了普鲁士控制的波罗的海沿岸重镇科尔贝格（今波兰科沃布热格）。1758年末和1760年的两次围城均告失败；1761年8月至12月，俄军最终攻下这座城，围城期间还有瑞典辅助部队参战。

en.s: The Muharram Rebellion (Bengali: মহররম বিদ্রোহ) was a Bengali uprising which took place in early December 1782 against the East India Company in colonial Sylhet, eastern Bengal (now Bangladesh). The rebellion was under the leadership of the Pirzada and his two brothers, Syed Muhammad Hadi and Syed Muhammad Mahdi. The main battle took place in the Mughal-built Sylhet Shahi Eidgah and its surrounding hills.
en.n: British East India Company: Muharram Rebellion: Hada and Mada Miah lead the first anti-British uprising in the subcontinent against Robert Lindsay and his contingents in Sylhet Shahi Eidgah.

zh.s: 穆哈兰姆起义是1782年12月孟加拉东部锡尔赫特地区反抗东印度公司的起义，由皮尔扎达及其兄弟赛义德·穆罕默德·哈迪、赛义德·穆罕默德·马赫迪领导。主要战斗发生在莫卧儿时期建造的锡尔赫特沙希清真寺及周边山丘。
zh.n: 不列颠东印度公司：穆哈兰姆起义：哈达和马达·米亚兄弟在锡尔赫特沙希清真寺领导了次大陆的首次反英起义，对抗罗伯特·林赛及其部队。

en.s: The Battle of Cardadeu on 16 December 1808 saw an Imperial French corps led by Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr assault a Spanish force commanded by Juan Miguel de Vives y Feliu and Theodor von Reding. Saint-Cyr won the engagement by forming most of his troops into gigantic attack columns and smashing through the Spanish lines. Cardedeu is located 17 kilometres (11 mi) northeast of Barcelona, Spain. The action occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. By the fall of 1808, a French corps under Guillaume Philibert Duhesme was besieged in Barcelona by a 24,000-man Spanish army led by Vives.

zh.s: 卡尔德德乌战役发生于1808年12月16日。由洛朗·古维翁-圣西尔率领的法兰西帝国军团进攻胡安·米格尔·德·比韦斯·费利乌和特奥多尔·冯·雷丁指挥的西班牙军队。圣西尔把大部分部队编成大型纵队，突破西班牙军阵并赢得交战。卡尔德德乌位于西班牙巴塞罗那东北约17公里处。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。1808年秋，吉约姆·菲利贝尔·迪埃姆斯率领的法军被比韦斯指挥的2.4万名西班牙军队围困在巴塞罗那。

en.t: Battle of Cardedeu order of battle
en.s: The Cardedeu order of battle lists the troops that fought in the Battle of Cardedeu (16 December 1808) and several other battles fought between June and December in the Spanish province of Catalonia during the Peninsular War. In February 1808, Imperial French forces seized Barcelona on 29 February and Sant Ferran Castle on 15 March as well as other fortresses in Spain.

zh.s: 卡德德乌战役序列列出了半岛战争期间参加卡德德乌战役（1808年12月16日）及其他几场战斗的部队。这些战斗于当年6月至12月在西班牙加泰罗尼亚省进行。1808年2月，法帝国军队于29日攻占巴塞罗那，并于3月15日攻占圣费兰城堡及西班牙其他要塞。

en.s: The siege of Tortosa (16 December 1810 – 2 January 1811) pitted an Imperial French army under General Louis Gabriel Suchet against the Spanish defenders of Tortosa led by General Miguel de Lili Idiáquez, Conde de Alacha. The siege progressed swiftly and Alacha surrendered on 2 January 1811. The action took place during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 托尔托萨围城战从1810年12月16日持续至1811年1月2日，交战双方为路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇将军指挥的法国帝国军队，以及米格尔·德利利·伊迪亚克斯将军、阿拉查伯爵率领的托尔托萨西班牙守军。围城进展迅速，阿拉查于1811年1月2日投降。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间，属于拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The 1811–1812 New Madrid earthquakes were a series of intense intraplate earthquakes beginning with an initial earthquake of moment magnitude 7.2–8.2 on December 16, 1811, followed by a moment magnitude 7.4 aftershock on the same day. Two additional earthquakes of similar magnitude followed in January and February 1812. They remain the most powerful earthquakes to hit the contiguous United States east of the Rocky Mountains in recorded history.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1811—1812年新马德里地震是一系列强烈的板内地震。首次地震发生于1811年12月16日，矩震级为7.2至8.2级，当天随后又发生一次7.4级余震。1812年1月和2月又发生了两次震级相近的地震。根据有记录以来的资料，这是落基山脉以东、美国本土范围内最强烈的一系列地震。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的当地日期。

en.s: The Battle of Blood River (Afrikaans: Slag van Bloedrivier; Zulu: iMpi yaseNcome) is the name given for the battle fought between 470 Voortrekkers ("Pioneers"), led by Andries Pretorius, and an estimated 15,000–21,000 Zulu attackers on the bank of the Ncome River on 16 December 1838, in what is today KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Casualties amounted to 3,000 of king Dingane's soldiers dead, including two Zulu princes competing with prince Mpande for the Zulu throne. Three Pioneers commando members were lightly wounded, including Pretorius himself.

zh.s: 血河之战（南非语：Slag van Bloedrivier；祖鲁语：iMpi yaseNcome）发生于1838年12月16日，交战双方是安德里斯·普雷托里乌斯率领的470名布尔拓荒者（Voortrekkers，即“先驱者”）和估计1.5万至2.1万名祖鲁进攻者，战场位于今天南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省的恩科姆河畔。丁干国王一方约有3000名士兵阵亡，其中包括两名正与姆潘德王子争夺祖鲁王位的王子。拓荒者突击队有3人轻伤，其中包括普雷托里乌斯本人。

en.s: The Capture of Tucson was an uncontested United States entry into the Mexican city of Tucson, Sonora, now the present day Tucson, Arizona. The would-be combatants were provisional Mexican Army troops and the American Army's "Mormon Battalion". Tucson temporarily 'fell' in December 1846 without resistance but was immediately reoccupied two days later by the Mexican forces once the US troops moved on.

zh.s: 1846年12月，美军不战而入墨西哥图森城（当时属索诺拉省，今属亚利桑那州）。图森只被美军短暂占领，两天后，美军离开后墨军立即重新控制了这座城市。

en.s: The Capture of Bien Hoa (Vietnamese: Biên Hòa) on 16 December 1861 was an important allied victory in the Cochinchina campaign (1858–62). This campaign, fought between the French and the Spanish on the one side and the Vietnamese on the other, began as a limited punitive expedition and ended as a French war of conquest. The war concluded with the establishment of the French colony of Cochinchina, a development that inaugurated nearly a century of French colonial dominance in Vietnam.

zh.s: 攻占边和发生于1861年12月16日，是1858至1862年交趾支那战役中盟军的一次重要胜利。交战双方是法国和西班牙联军与越南军队。这场战争最初是一次有限的惩罚性远征，后来演变为法国的征服战争；战争结束后，法国建立了交趾支那殖民地，开启了法国在越南近一个世纪的殖民统治。

en.s: The Battle of White Hall, also called the Battle of White Hall Ferry, took place on December 16, 1862, in Wayne County, North Carolina, as part of the Union expedition to Goldsboro, North Carolina, during the American Civil War.

en.s: The Battle of Nashville was a two-day battle in the Franklin–Nashville campaign that represented the end of large-scale fighting west of the coastal states in the American Civil War. It was fought at Nashville, Tennessee, on December 15–16, 1864, between the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Lieutenant General John Bell Hood and the Union Army of the Cumberland (Dept. of the Cumberland) (AoC) under Major General George H.

en.s: The Battle of Vientiane was the decisive action of the 1960 Laotian coups. Fought between 13 and 16 December 1960, the battle ended with General Phoumi Nosavan winning control of the Kingdom of Laos with the aid of the Royal Thai Government and the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency. Vientiane was left devastated by the fighting, with about 600 civilian dead, about the same number of homes destroyed, and 7,000 left homeless. The losing Forces Armées Neutralistes under Captain Kong Le retreated onto the strategic Plain of Jars, to begin an uneasy coexistence with the Pathet Lao and the invading People's Army of Vietnam.

The war began when the Pakistani military junta based in West Pakistan—under the orders of Yahya Khan—launched Operation Searchlight against East Pakistanis on the night of 25 March 1971, initiating the Bangladesh genocide.

en.t: The Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh is enacted
en.s: The Constitution of Bangladesh, officially the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, is the supreme law of Bangladesh. The constitution was adopted by the Constituent Assembly of Bangladesh on 4 November 1972, it came into effect on 16 December 1972. The constituent assembly was composed of officials elected in the national and provincial council elections of Pakistan held in 1970.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 16 December 2001. Initial results suggested a second round was necessary, as neither incumbent President Didier Ratsiraka nor Marc Ravalomanana, the two main candidates, had won a majority. However, Ravalomanana rejected the results and declared himself President in February 2002, resulting in violence breaking out between supporters of the two candidates. A recount was held, after which Ravalomanana was awarded 51.46% of the votes, and in April the High Constitutional Court declared him the winner. Although Ratsiraka rejected the verdict, the United States recognised Ravalomanana as President in June, and the following month Ratsiraka fled to France.

zh.s: 2001年12月16日，马达加斯加举行总统选举。初步结果显示需要举行第二轮投票，因为时任总统迪迪埃·拉齐拉卡和马克·拉瓦卢马纳纳这两位主要候选人都未获得过半选票。拉瓦卢马纳纳拒绝接受结果，并于2002年2月自行宣布就任总统，双方支持者随后发生暴力冲突。之后重新计票，拉瓦卢马纳纳得票率为51.46%；4月，最高宪法法院宣布他获胜。拉齐拉卡拒绝接受裁决，但美国于6月承认拉瓦卢马纳纳为总统；次月，拉齐拉卡逃往法国。

en.s: Local elections were held in Portugal on 16 December 2001. The elections consisted of three separate elections in the 308 Portuguese municipalities, the election for the Municipal Chambers, another election for the Municipal Assembly and a last one for the lower-level Parish Assembly, whose winner is elected parish president. This last was held separately in the more than 4,200 parishes around the country.

zh.s: 2001年12月16日，葡萄牙举行地方选举，在全国308个市镇分别进行三项选举：市政厅、市议会以及较低层级的堂区议会。堂区议会选举在全国4200多个堂区分别举行，获胜者将担任堂区主席。

en.s: The 2001 Lisbon local election was held on 16 December 2001 to elect the members of the Lisbon City Council. In an election that was considered an upset, incumbent mayor João Soares, running in a coalition between the Socialists, the Communists and the Greens, lost reelection against Pedro Santana Lopes, the Social Democratic candidate, who beat João Soares with a very narrow margin of less than 1,000 votes.

zh.s: 2001年12月16日，里斯本举行地方选举，选出里斯本市议会成员。被视为冷门的选举中，时任市长若昂·苏亚雷斯未能连任。他代表社会党、共产党和绿党的联合阵营参选，最终以不到1000票的微弱差距败给社会民主党候选人佩德罗·桑塔纳·洛佩斯。

en.s: The Moscow legislative election of 2001 was held on 16 December of that year to the fourth convocation of the Moscow City Duma. The elections were held according to a majoritarian system in 35 single-mandate constituencies. Every sixth candidate was registered on the basis of an electoral deposit (the amount of which is 450 thousand rubles).

en.s: Armageddon (2007) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) an took place on December 16, 2007, at the Mellon Arena in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The event, sponsored by Activision's Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, was the eighth event produced under the Armageddon name and starred wrestlers from the Raw, SmackDown!, and ECW brands. Eight professional wrestling matches were scheduled for the event, which featured a supercard, a scheduling of more than one main bout. The first of these was a Triple Threat match from the SmackDown brand that featured Edge defeating World Heavyweight Champion Batista and The Undertaker to win the title.

zh.s: 世界末日（2007）是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）举办的一场按次付费职业摔角赛事，于2007年12月16日在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的梅隆体育馆举行。赛事由动视的《使命召唤4：现代战争》赞助，是以“世界末日”为名举办的第八场赛事，参赛选手来自Raw、SmackDown!和ECW三个品牌。赛事安排了8场比赛，其中包括多场主要对决。首场主要比赛是SmackDown!品牌的三方威胁赛，Edge击败世界重量级冠军巴蒂斯塔和送葬者，夺得冠军。

en.s: The December 2007 Turkish incursion into northern Iraq, by the Turkish Air Force, began on 16 December 2007, when the Turkish Military bombed Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) targets in northern Iraq.

zh.s: 2007年12月16日，土耳其空军开始对伊拉克北部发动军事行动，轰炸库尔德工人党（PKK）的目标。

en.s: The 2007 FIFA Club World Cup final took place at the Nissan Stadium, Yokohama, Japan on 16 December 2007. The match pitted Boca Juniors of Argentina, the CONMEBOL club champions, against Milan of Italy, the UEFA club champions. Milan won 4–2 in a match watched by 68,263 people. In doing so, Milan became the first non-Brazilian team – and first European – to win the Club World Cup.

zh.t: 2007年国际足联俱乐部世界杯决赛
zh.s: 2007年国际足联俱乐部世界杯决赛于2007年12月16日在日本横滨日产体育场举行。阿根廷博卡青年队（南美洲足联冠军）对阵意大利AC米兰队（欧洲足联冠军），AC米兰以4比2获胜，现场观众为68263人。AC米兰也因此成为首支赢得俱乐部世界杯冠军的非巴西球队和欧洲球队。

en.s: Gujarat's twelfth legislative election was held in 2007. In this election, the BJP led by Narendra Modi won 117 seats out of 182 (ten seats fewer than in 2002). Congress improved its performance and won 59 seats (eight more than last election). Modi fought elections in Maninagar and won with a major majority. NCP won three seats, JDU won only one seat and independent candidates won only two seats.

en.t: Arena Naucalpan stages its 33rd anniversary wrestling show
en.s: On December 16, 2010, International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) held the Arena Naucalpan 33rd Anniversary Show at its home venue in Naucalpan, Mexico. Before IWRG was established, the arena had hosted shows associated with the Universal Wrestling Association and Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre. Arena owner and wrestling promoter Adolfo Moreno founded IWRG in 1996.

zh.s: 2010年12月16日，国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）在墨西哥瑙卡尔潘的主场举办竞技场33周年纪念赛。IWRG成立前，这座场馆曾与环球摔角协会（UWA）和世界摔角理事会（CMLL）合作举办赛事。场馆所有者、摔角推广人阿道夫·莫雷诺于1996年创办IWRG。

The event was the first time that Zuffa has hosted an event in Arizona. This was the final WEC event, due to the merger with the UFC.

en.s: Sin Piedad (2011) (Spanish for "No Mercy") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), which took place on December 16, 2011, in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico and replaced CMLL's regular Friday night show Super Viernes ("Super Friday"). The 2011 Sin Piedad was the tenth event under that name that CMLL promoted as their last major show of the year, always held in December. The main event of the show centered around a long running storyline between Blue Panther and the Casas wrestling family, represented by El Felino in this instance.

zh.s: 《毫不留情》（2011）是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的年度大型职业摔角赛事，于2011年12月16日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，取代了CMLL每周五的常规节目《超级星期五》。这是CMLL以“毫不留情”为名举办的第10场赛事，也是该组织当年的最后一场大型赛事，通常安排在12月举行。主赛围绕蓝豹与卡萨斯摔角家族之间持续多年的剧情展开；卡萨斯家族由埃尔·费利诺代表出战。

en.s: The Zhanaozen massacre (Kazakh: Жаңаөзен оқиғасы, romanized: Jañaözen oqiğasy) took place in Kazakhstan's western Mangystau Region over the weekend of 16–17 December 2011. At least 14 protesters were killed by police in the oil town of Zhanaozen as they clashed with police on the country's Independence Day, with unrest spreading to other towns in the oil-rich oblys, or region.

zh.s: 扎瑙津惨案发生于2011年12月16日至17日的周末，地点在哈萨克斯坦西部的曼格斯套州。独立日当天，石油城镇扎瑙津发生示威者与警方冲突，警方至少打死14名示威者；该州其他城镇也出现了骚乱。

en.s: A general election was held in Japan on 16 December 2012. Voters gave the Liberal Democratic Party a landslide victory, ejecting the Democratic Party of Japan from power after three years. It was the fourth worst defeat suffered by a ruling party in Japanese history. Voting took place in all representatives' constituencies of Japan including proportional blocks, in order to appoint Members of Diet to seats in the House of Representatives, the lower house of the National Diet of Japan. This was the 46th general election of members of the House of Representatives (第46回衆議院議員総選挙 dai-yonjūrokkai Shūgiin giin sōsenkyo) in Japan since 1869.

zh.s: 2012年12月16日，日本举行众议院选举。自民党大胜，执政3年的民主党下台。这是日本历史上执政党遭遇的第四严重败选。全国各众议院选区及比例代表区都举行了投票，以选出国会众议院议员。这是日本自1869年以来第46次众议院选举。

en.s: TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs (2012) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE, which took place on December 16, 2012, at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. It was the fourth annual TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs event, the first professional wrestling event to be held at the Barclays Center, and WWE's first event held in Brooklyn. In addition to the event, winners of several categories of the WWE Slammy Awards were announced in the pre-show. The event also marks the in-ring debut of The Shield. The event received 175,000 pay-per-view buys, down from 179,000 buys the previous year.

zh.s: 《桌子、梯子与椅子大赛》（2012）是WWE举办的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于2012年12月16日在纽约布鲁克林的巴克莱中心举行。这是该系列第4场年度赛事，也是巴克莱中心举办的首场职业摔角赛事和WWE在布鲁克林举办的首场赛事。赛前节目公布了多项WWE Slammy奖的得主。该赛事也是“神盾军团”的首次擂台亮相。赛事获得17.5万次付费点播，比前一年的17.9万次有所下降。

en.s: The Democratic Party leadership election was held on 16 December 2012 for the leadership including chairman, two vice-chairman posts and 27 members of the 10th Central Committee of the Democratic Party in Hong Kong. The incumbent acting Chairwomen Emily Lau defeated Vice-Chairman Sin Chung-kai by a narrow margin, becoming the first Chairwoman of the party. 300 party members voted in the election.

zh.s: 香港民主党于2012年12月16日举行领导层选举，选出主席、两名副主席以及第十届中央委员会的27名成员。时任署理主席刘慧卿以微弱优势击败副主席单仲偕，成为该党首位女性主席。共有300名党员投票。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Venezuela on 16 December 2012 to elect state governors and state legislators. The result was a victory for the ruling United Socialist Party, which won the governorships of 20 of the 23 states, an increase from the 18 won in the 2008 elections. Voter turnout was 53%.

zh.s: 2012年12月16日，委内瑞拉举行地方选举，选出各州州长和州议员。执政的统一社会主义党获胜，拿下23个州中的20个州长职位，比2008年选举时增加2个。投票率为53%。

en.s: The 2012 FIFA Club World Cup final was the final match of the 2012 FIFA Club World Cup, an association football tournament hosted in Japan. It was the ninth final of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised tournament between the winners of the six continental confederations as well as the host nation's league champions. The final was contested between CONMEBOL winners Corinthians and UEFA winners Chelsea, and took place at the International Stadium Yokohama in Yokohama on 16 December 2012.

zh.t: 2012年国际足联俱乐部世界杯决赛
zh.s: 2012年国际足联俱乐部世界杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。这是国际足联俱乐部世界杯的第9场决赛；赛事由国际足联主办，参赛队伍包括六大洲足联冠军以及东道主联赛冠军。决赛由南美洲足联冠军科林蒂安对阵欧洲足联冠军切尔西，于2012年12月16日在横滨国际综合竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2013 Manila Skyway bus accident occurred on December 16, 2013, between Bicutan and Sucat Exits of South Luzon Expressway in Parañaque, Metro Manila, Philippines, after a bus fell off the Skyway, crushing a delivery van and fatally wounding the van's driver. 19 people died and 19 others were injured. The Highway Patrol Group-National Capital Region-South Luzon Expressway described the incident as the worst to have happened along the Skyway.

zh.t: 2013年马尼拉高架公路公交车事故
zh.s: 2013年12月16日，马尼拉高架公路发生公交车事故。地点在菲律宾大马尼拉地区帕拉尼亚克市南吕宋高速公路的比库坦和苏卡特出口之间。一辆公交车从高架公路坠落，压毁一辆送货车，并导致车内司机死亡。事故共造成19人死亡、另有19人受伤。首都区高速公路巡逻队称，这是该高架公路上发生过的最严重事故。

en.s: On 16 December 2014, seven gunmen affiliated with the Tehrik-i-Taliban (TTP) conducted a terrorist attack on the Army Public School in the northwestern Pakistani city of Peshawar. The militants, all of whom were foreign nationals, included one Chechen, three Arabs and two Afghans. They entered the school and opened fire on school staff and children, killing 141 people, including 132 schoolchildren, ranging between eight and eighteen years of age. A rescue operation was launched by the Pakistan Army's Special Services Group (SSG) special forces, who killed all seven terrorists and rescued 960 people.

zh.s: 2014年12月16日，7名与巴基斯坦塔利班运动（TTP）有关联的武装人员袭击巴基斯坦西北部城市白沙瓦的陆军公立学校。袭击者均为外国人，其中包括1名车臣人、3名阿拉伯人和2名阿富汗人。他们进入学校后向教职员工和学生开枪，共造成141人死亡，其中132名遇难学生年龄在8至18岁之间。巴基斯坦军方特种服务组（SSG）随后展开营救行动，击毙全部7名袭击者，并救出960人。

en.s: The 2017 FIFA Club World Cup final was the final match of the 2017 FIFA Club World Cup, the 14th edition of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised football tournament contested by the winners of the six continental confederations, as well as the host nation's league champions. The final was played at the Zayed Sports City Stadium in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates on 16 December 2017 and was contested between Spanish club and title holders Real Madrid, representing UEFA as the reigning champions of the UEFA Champions League, and Brazilian club Grêmio, representing CONMEBOL as the reigning champions of the Copa Libertadores.

en.t: December 2021 Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election
en.s: The December 2021 Christian Democratic Union leadership election was held in December 2021. The leader of the party was elected indirectly by a party convention, for the first time the CDU held a vote by the membership to decide the candidate which the party's executive board proposed to the party convention. Though the convention is not obliged to elect the proposed candidates, the membership vote is considered politically binding.

en.s: The 2024 NCAA Division I men's soccer championship game (also known as the 2024 NCAA Division I Men's College Cup) was played on December 16, 2024, at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary, North Carolina. The match determined the winner of the 2024 NCAA Division I men's soccer tournament, the national collegiate soccer championship in the United States.
